$comment: testIDs that exist only for end-to-end runs (test builds), on top of the Toybox screen testID contract in screen-testids.json. check-flows.mjs accepts every id listed here, in screen-testids.json (elements and notDrawn) and in apps/<game-id>/e2e/testids.json. game.board-layout and game.moves-label are drawn only while the debug link set boardLayout=1: send boardLayout=1 in the setup QUERY before a flow reads them.

testIDs.debug.network-attempts: Debug screen (S15), test builds: the JS network guard's attempt counter, drawn under the fourteen rows (below the fold on a phone: scroll to it). Every smoke flow ends by asserting its text is '0' (subflows/assert-no-network.yaml).
testIDs.game.board-layout: Game screen (S5), test builds with boardLayout=1 only: one small Text whose content is JSON.stringify({ x, y, layout }) (the canvas origin in window points plus the game's BoardLayout), so flows can tap board cells. Drawn by the board host's layout probe (board-rendering-skia: game-host/board-layout-probe.tsx).
testIDs.game.moves-label: Game screen (S5), test builds with boardLayout=1 only: the run's move count as one small Text ('1' after the first move), so a flow can prove a tap made a move and that the move survived a kill. Drawn by the Game screen's moves probe (screens/game/game-moves-probe.tsx, shipped with the S5 Game screen templates); the design draws the game's progress line instead.

gameFlowIds.$comment: Screen-map ids the game flow templates rely on (listed here so a change to the map is seen against the flows; check-flows reads them from screen-testids.json, where each one is an element or a notDrawn id).
gameFlowIds.levels.level-tile.1: smoke/10-level-1.yaml: after the win, the tile's VoiceOver label carries the stars earned ('Level 1: 3 stars'; the stars themselves are crop-only parts inside it).
gameFlowIds.levels.level-tile.2: smoke/10-level-1.yaml: tapped after the win; level 2 is unlocked when it opens game.screen instead of levels.locked-toast.
gameFlowIds.levels.locked-toast: smoke/10-level-1.yaml: must not show after the tap on level 2.
gameFlowIds.game.mode-label: smoke/10-level-1.yaml and journeys/12-continue-premium.yaml: the level the run shows ('Level 2', 'Level 1').
gameFlowIds.daily.play-button: journeys/11-daily.yaml: S9's Play key, the key under test, starts today's run; after the next day it is offered again.
gameFlowIds.result.daily-title: journeys/11-daily.yaml: the daily result after action=win-level.
gameFlowIds.result.streak-sticker: journeys/11-daily.yaml: the streak sticker of the daily result.
gameFlowIds.result.come-back-note: journeys/11-daily.yaml: the come-back note of the daily result.
gameFlowIds.daily.replay-button: journeys/11-daily.yaml: not shown on the next day (today is not done).
gameFlowIds.result.continue-premium-button: journeys/12-continue-premium.yaml: the Premium owner's free continue after action=lose-level (E2E builds run with ads off, so the rewarded result.continue-ad-button never shows).
gameFlowIds.result.continue-ad-button: journeys/12-continue-premium.yaml: must not show for a Premium owner.
gameFlowIds.home.endless-card: journeys/13-endless.yaml: starts the endless run; afterwards its label ('Endless – Best <n>') carries a best above 0.
gameFlowIds.result.endless-title: journeys/13-endless.yaml: the endless result after action=lose-level.
gameFlowIds.result.score-card.new-best: journeys/13-endless.yaml: New best! after the first endless run.
gameFlowIds.result.home-button: journeys/13-endless.yaml: back to Home from the endless result.
